# Autonomous Mode

> A personal AI system for independent consultants (US, UK, Canada; practices of 1-10 people), installed by Ato Sam. It holds the consultant's clients, offers, priorities and voice in one place, runs their recurring work as commands, checks drafts against their voice, and keeps itself current with a weekly review. Built on Claude (Anthropic).

## Offer
- First command (a morning brief from inbox and calendar) within 48 hours; fully set up in 14 days; 60 days of support.
- Six parts: Practice Brain, three commands, Voice Lock, Guardrails (drafts only), Weekly Review, Handover Kit. Includes Voice Note to Post.
- Guarantee 1 (risk of starting): full refund, no reason needed, if the client decides by day 7 that it isn't for them; everything set up is removed.
- Guarantee 2: if by day 30 it isn't saving at least three hours a week against a baseline of their recurring work written down on the intake call, work continues at no charge until it does.
- Price: $7,500 USD one time. Two founding places at $3,750 in exchange for a case study. Optional care $1,500/month after day 74. Claude subscription billed separately by Anthropic.
